description: Table 3 is a two-column table (header row "Algorithm" | "Parameter configurations") that records the hyperparameter settings of four metaheuristic optimizers. Row FA: max_iter = 500, firefly_num = 100, alpha = 0.01, betamin = 0.2, gamma = 1. Row SA: max_iter = 500, initial_temperature = 100, cooling_rate = 0.95. Row PSO: max_iter = 500, particle_num = 100, c1 = 0.8, c2 = 0.5, w = 0.5. Row GWO: max_iter = 500, num_wolves = 100, alpha = 2, beta = 1.5, delta = 0.5, a = 2. All four algorithms are capped at the identical max_iter = 500 and an identical population of 100 agents (fireflies/particles/wolves), so the FA-SA-PSO-GWO comparison is controlled for iteration budget and swarm size. The FA and GWO cells end with a trailing comma, implying the printed parameter list continues. No axes, units, data points or error bars appear: the table is purely a configuration record. The caption states it gives the parameter configurations of the optimization algorithms; the citing text adds that FA, SA, PSO and GWO were used to determine elemental content, after which microhardness was optimized by the selected ML model.

observations.observation: The table has exactly two columns, headed "Algorithm" and "Parameter configurations".
Four algorithm rows are present, labelled FA, SA, PSO and GWO in that order.
The FA row reads: max_iter = 500, firefly_num = 100, alpha = 0.01, betamin = 0.2, gamma = 1.
The SA row reads: max_iter = 500, initial_temperature = 100, cooling_rate = 0.95.
The PSO row reads: max_iter = 500, particle_num = 100, c1 = 0.8, c2 = 0.5, w = 0.5.
The GWO row reads: max_iter = 500, num_wolves = 100, alpha = 2, beta = 1.5, delta = 0.5, a = 2.
All four algorithms share the same iteration budget max_iter = 500.
All four algorithms use a population of 100 search agents, printed under different names (firefly_num, particle_num, num_wolves).
The FA and GWO cells terminate with a trailing comma, indicating the parameter list as printed may be incomplete.
The caption states that Table 3 shows the parameter configurations of the optimization algorithms.

The citing text states that elemental content was determined using the firefly optimization algorithm (FA), simulated annealing algorithm (SA), particle swarm optimization (PSO) and grey wolf optimization algorithm (GWO), and that Table 3 shows their parameter configurations.
The citing text states that the microhardness was optimized by the selected ML model after the algorithms were applied.

The citing text lists the optimized elements as C, Si, Mn, Cr, S, Ni, P, Mo, V and W with composition ranges [0.02 wt%, 2 wt%], [0.1 wt%, 1 wt%], [0.15 wt%, 2 wt%], [0.5 wt%, 25 wt%], [0, 0.035 wt%], [0, 2 wt%], [0, 0.045 wt%], [0, 3 wt%], [0, 0.5 wt%] and [0, 2 wt%] respectively; these ranges are not printed in the table itself.
